description: Lists the connections of a WinCC Unified HMI as {hmi, connections:[{name, communicationDriver, station, partner, node, initialAddress, disabledAtStartup, comment, plc}], total, nextCursor, inventoryGaps}; `plc` is the name of the one PLC the partner resolves to, or null when none or several match. Use it before creating an external tag: the connection must exist and plc says whether plcName can be left out. For a large HMI read it in pages: pass limit (1-1000), then pass the nextCursor of each page as cursor until nextCursor is null; total is the number of connections of the whole list. Without limit and cursor the whole list is returned with nextCursor null. A cursor of a list that changed is 409 cursor_stale (restart without cursor), one that is not a nextCursor is 400 invalid_cursor. `inventoryGaps` [{kind, subject, reason}] lists every value or object the serve could not read while building the answer (empty when all reads succeeded): the unreadable value is null and one gap names it, so a null next to a gap means unreadable, while a value the object does not offer is null without a gap. Needs an open project and a WinCC Unified HMI (hmi = its name from tia_hmis, matched ignoring case): a classic WinCC HMI is refused with 409 hmi_not_unified, an unknown HMI is 404 not_found and two HMIs with the same name are 409 ambiguous_name. Maps to GET /hmi/{hmi}/connections?limit=&cursor= (both optional). Read-only (class R).

cursor.description: the nextCursor of the previous page, passed back exactly as received; it is opaque, so never invent, build or edit one (omit it for the first page, and omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)

hmi.description: HMI name, as listed by tia_hmis (a WinCC Unified HMI)

limit.description: page size, an integer from 1 to 1000; pass it to read the list in pages (omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)

name: tia_hmi_connections
title: TIA — HMI Unified connections
